create_flux_cfg_pipeline: create a FluxCFGPipeline instance for text-to-image generation with classifier-free guidance
run_flux_text_to_image: run the FluxCFGPipeline __call__ method to generate images from text prompts with true CFG support
encode_text_prompts: encode text prompts using CLIP and T5 text encoders with optional negative prompts for CFG
prepare_image_latents: prepare latent tensors with packing, image IDs, and proper device/dtype for Flux transformer input
calculate_scheduler_shift: calculate the shift parameter for FlowMatchEulerDiscreteScheduler based on image sequence length
